PluginInfo.Name: File Transfer
PluginInfo.ShortDescription: Browse and transfer files using FTP, SFTP and SCP.
PluginInfo.Description:
Browse and transfer files using FTP, SFTP and SCP.

The File Transfer Plugin for Royal TSX provides support for browsing and transferring files on FTP, SFTP and SCP file servers.

General
  • Support for FTP
  • Support for FTP with Implicit SSL
  • Support for FTP with Explicit TLS/SSL
  • Support for SFTP
  • Support for SCP
  • Dual-pane file browser
  • Live editing (automatically upload locally changed files)
  • Quick Look Support
  • Support for Bonjour discovery of FTP and SFTP hosts

Advanced Features
  • Support for Passive Mode
  • Support for specifying initial paths
  • Support for showing hidden files and directories
  • Support for overwriting or skipping all files of a transfer
  • Support for restoring timestamps after file transfers
  • Support viewing and changing permissions
  • Support for using large buffers for file transfers
  • Support for specifying SFTP custom command
  • Certificate validation
  • Proxy support
  • Secure Gateway support
